name: Proxy Lite
notes: The repository is the scaffold for Convergence AI's proxy-lite-3b model: a CLI (proxy), a Streamlit app and a Runner that loops a solver and a webbrowser environment. By default it calls a demo endpoint on Hugging Face Spaces, which the README says is not suitable for production; it recommends serving convergence-ai/proxy-lite-3b with vLLM and the hermes tool-call parser. The webbrowser environment (src/proxy_lite/environments/webbrowser.py) launches Chromium through Playwright with playwright_stealth, injects JavaScript to find interactable elements, and by default sends a screenshot annotated with numbered bounding boxes plus a text list of the marked elements; earlier screenshots are dropped from the context. BrowserTool exposes goto, google_search, click, type, scroll, back, wait, reload and do_nothing actions addressed by mark_id. The README says the model is meant to complete tasks autonomously and may struggle with logins or user-confirmed steps. Model weights are not in this repository. Code was read, not run.
summary: Convergence AI's open-weights web agent runner: a Playwright Chromium loop that sends annotated screenshots and numbered element lists to proxy-lite-3b and executes its click, type, scroll and navigation tool calls.
